praise.name: Location next to the Old Port

quotes.quote: Steps from the Old Port and every restaurant we wanted
Walkable to everything in the Old Port
Perfect base for exploring the Old Port on foot
The blueberry pancakes alone are worth the stay
Breakfast was excellent, the pancakes especially
The staff remembered our names by day two
wish we'd known parking was a block away
Parking situation was confusing, no instructions anywhere before arrival
Check-in isn't until 4 PM which we didn't realise

headline: Steps from the Old Port, with a breakfast guests write home about.
adLines: Walk to every restaurant in the Old Port.
